body:
## What this ticket includes

This WeGoTrip product (27089) combines two things: a **skip-the-line ticket to the Acropolis of Athens** and a **self-guided audio walk** through the city centre, which you play on your own smartphone. The inclusions list entry to the Acropolis site and its slopes, the **Parthenon**, the **Theatre of Dionysus Eleuthereus** and the **Odeon of Herodes Atticus**. The audio part comes with a stop-by-stop GPS map, narration, photos and text, and it works offline once downloaded.

There is no guide of any kind: in-person guide, guided tour and live guide are all listed as excluded. **Access to the Acropolis Museum is not included either.** You also need your own earphones and phone.

On 11 November 2026 the listing showed **from €59.25** (€50.36 with a WeGoTrip subscription) for ages 5–64. It was rated **4.0 out of 5 from 276 ratings and 103 reviews**. The audio is in English, and the listing openly says the tour content was **generated by AI**.

## How the route works

The walk starts at **Hadrian's Library** (Areos 3), near Monastiraki station. It runs about **5 km** and takes **2 h 30 min to 3 h**. It passes the Roman Agora before climbing to the Acropolis, then continues to the Theatre of Dionysus and Hadrian's Arch and ends in the National Gardens. Nobody meets you at the start, so you can begin whenever you like.

At the Acropolis you go to the turnstiles at the **main (west) entrance** and have your PDF ticket scanned.

## What to check before booking

1. **No re-entry.** Once you leave the Acropolis site you cannot go back in. Plan your photo stops before you exit.
2. **Heat closures.** The listing warns that the site may close in very high daytime temperatures, and that surfaces can be slippery when wet or windy. Wear non-slip shoes.
3. **Accessibility.** There is an elevator for visitors with limited mobility and for parents with two or more children. Arrange it in advance on +30 210 3214172. It does not run in bad weather or during maintenance.
4. **You may not need to pay full price.** According to the listing, EU citizens under 25 and non-EU visitors under 18 can get free tickets at the site, with no guarantee of a free time slot. There is also free entry on the first Sunday of each month from November to March. If any of that applies to you, compare before you buy.
5. **Download first.** You need Android 7.1+ or iOS 12+ and about 100 MB of free space. Download the tour over Wi-Fi before your visit.
6. **Cancellation terms are behind a link.** The page only says that policies vary by activity type and links to the conditions for *Entry ticket + Audio tour*.
